title: Switcharoo
summary: DI Parker is flown in to sign off on a supposed suicide, where a woman was found electrocuted in a hotel bathtub.
method: The husband put sleeping pills in the victim's champagne at the party, leading her to go back to her hotel room early. The receptionist set up the neighbouring room first, turning off the electricity and plugging in the hair dryer. She and the victim's husband moved the victim into the bathroom in her room and electrocuted her. The victim's husband then broke the locks on the doors and left the room. When the hotel worker showed up, they broke into the neighbouring room and it was actually the receptionist who was in the bathtub, dressed up like the wife. After the worker left to call for help, the husband switched the DND signs on the room and went to the actual hotel room where the body was. The victim wore a mouth guard which was an indicator that she didn't intend to commit suicide.
motive: He works for the victim's father's company, so the affair would've cost him his marriage and his job.
killer: the victim's husband and the hotel receptionist (with whom he was having an affair)
notes: DI Parker's first episode on the island.
